operators.customDisplayName: Load all fraud and other data CSV files from State MSA Fraud and Other data folder using glob pattern matching
Load all identity theft data CSV files from State MSA Identity Theft data folder using glob pattern matching

operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_fraud_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_fraud_data.copy()
    df.columns = ['metropolitan_area', 'fraud_reports']
    df = df[df['metropolitan_area'].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df[df['metropolitan_area'] != 'Metropolitan Area'].reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df[~df['metropolitan_area'].str.contains('Source:', na=False)].reset_index(drop=True)
    df['fraud_reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['fraud_reports'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['fraud_reports'].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

operators.customDisplayName: Clean fraud data: standardize column names, remove NaN rows, filter out header and source rows, convert fraud_reports to numeric

operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_identity_theft_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_identity_theft_data.copy()
    df.columns = ['metropolitan_area', 'theft_reports']
    df = df[df['metropolitan_area'].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df[df['metropolitan_area'] != 'Metropolitan Area'].reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df[~df['metropolitan_area'].str.contains('Source:', na=False)].reset_index(drop=True)
    df['theft_reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['theft_reports'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['theft_reports'].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

operators.customDisplayName: Clean identity theft data: standardize column names, remove NaN rows, filter out header and source rows, convert theft_reports to numeric

operatorProperties.code:
def process(clean_fraud_data, clean_identity_theft_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    merged = clean_fraud_data.merge(clean_identity_theft_data, on='metropolitan_area', how='inner')
    merged['theft_exceeds_fraud'] = merged['theft_reports'] > merged['fraud_reports']
    return merged

Check if any metropolitan area has identity theft reports exceeding fraud reports. Returns Yes or No.
